name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd
title: Ventive Hospitality Ltd - 544321 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Hospitality-led growth with rate-led India (ADR +13%) and Maldives occupancy gains, but Q4 EBITDA growth was 8% ex-FX gain and management gave no numeric guidance, with April–May Maldives traffic data contested.

utilisation.quote: Occupancy improved by 5 percentage points to 63% and TRevPAR was at INR 60,000.

capex.quote: our capex for next three years will be around INR 1,000 crores for our Bangalore hotel, for our Sri Lanka hotel and some FF&E

triggers.label: Q4 underlying EBITDA growth 8% ex-FX
triggers.quote: Adjusting for foreign exchange gain in both periods, the underlying EBITDA growth for the quarter was 8%.

triggers.label: Maldives April traffic down ~25% (analyst data)
triggers.quote: I guess the April traffic was down almost 25% and the first 10 days of May was down 15%.

triggers.label: India ADR up 13% for FY26
triggers.quote: ADR for India business was INR 12,516 up 13% while RevPAR grew 10% to 7,952.

triggers.label: Mundra project put on hold
triggers.quote: we also reassessed the Mundra opportunity and have decided to keep it on hold for now.

guidance.value: low-teen revenue growth and high-teen EBITDA growth
guidance.quote: Ventive can in my view deliver low-teen revenue growth and high-teen EBITDA growth.
we are on track to achieve occupancy north of 65% for these resorts in the medium term.
we are confident of ramping up occupancy to 75% in the medium term.

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA growth flattered by FX gain
red_flags.quote: The results include a foreign exchange gain of INR 74 crores in Q4 FY26. Adjusting for foreign exchange gain in both periods, the underlying EBITDA growth for the quarter was 8%.

red_flags.label: Analyst-cited Maldives traffic decline vs management view
red_flags.quote: I guess the April traffic was down almost 25% and the first 10 days of May was down 15%.

red_flags.label: Diesel supply risk for Maldives
red_flags.quote: Yes, it will have an impact. But it's exactly how hard or when it's a little bit difficult to say at this stage.

evasions.quote: Achal I'll have to study which immigration number is this because you know the new airport has opened.
So far at this stage, we have visibility of only Q1 and while there is some volatility
